name: @omniclaw/price-tracking
description: Redis Streams Price Tracking System with stealth scraping and real-time alerts

scripts.init: node -e "const coordinator = require('./services/price-tracking-coordinator'); const c = new coordinator(); c.initialize().then(() => console.log('Initialized')).catch(console.error);"
